items.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: one standalone realistic 4:3 image for an Arabic visual guessing game.
Input image 1: edit target of a bamboo pan flute. Correct the anatomy of this instrument.
Primary request: show one bamboo pan flute consisting of side-by-side pipes with all OPEN mouth ends aligned in one straight upper horizontal row. The pipes progressively decrease in length from left to right, so the CLOSED natural bamboo-node lower ends form a graduated lower edge. Use a slightly elevated front three-quarter view so the hollow open upper mouths and sealed lower tips are both unambiguous. Keep the bamboo material, binding cord, rustic wood support, natural warm light and quiet background. Keep the complete instrument inside frame with margin.
Constraints: open ends ONLY at the aligned upper playing edge; NO open holes along the staggered lower edge; no hands, labels, captions, readable text, watermark, frames or tile cuts.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: one standalone 4:3 image for a visual guessing game.
Input image 1: edit target, an ornate concert harp in a sunlit room.
Primary request: widen the framing around the same harp so its entire upper decorative finial, frame, base, pedals and feet are clearly inside the image, with at least 8% clear margin above the finial and some floor below. Preserve the recognizable triangular harp frame, many strings, curved neck, wood and gold materials, room, light and perspective. The complete instrument should occupy about 75% of image height.
Constraints: change only composition/framing as needed for complete visibility; no cropped instrument parts, no labels, writing, logos, watermark, tile lines or borders.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: one standalone 4:3 image for a visual guessing game.
Input image 1: edit target, yellow tracked excavator on a construction site.
Primary request: widen the framing to show the complete same excavator including its highest boom joint and pivot with at least 8% clear sky above, and the full bucket and tracks with surrounding margin. Preserve correct connected hydraulic boom, arm, bucket, cab and tracked chassis, yellow paint, natural light, and construction-site background. Vehicle should occupy about 75% of image height.
Constraints: no part of the vehicle cropped, no added equipment, text, logos, labels, watermark, tile cuts or borders.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: one 4:3 landscape image for a visual guessing game.
Input image 1 is the edit target: traditional Gulf windcatcher tower.
Primary request: zoom the camera out substantially so the whole tower, including its complete roof cornice, is visible with a wide clear band of sky above (at least 15% of image height). The tower's entire upper edge must be separated from the image border. Retain this tower's distinctive vertical ventilation openings, earthen plaster, projecting wooden beams and Gulf courtyard setting. Keep the original perspective, lighting and believable architecture. Tower should occupy no more than 65% of image height.
Constraints: no cropped roof or upper tower; no captions, names, labels, signs, watermark or tile cuts.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: one realistic 4:3 landscape image for a visual guessing game.
Input image 1 is the edit target: brass astrolabe.
Primary request: reframe to show the COMPLETE astrolabe with the entire suspension ring and any top knob clearly inside the frame, with at least 12% quiet background above it and below the disk. Display it resting upright on a small unobtrusive support; do not suspend it from a cropped chain. Preserve the brass disk, openwork star-pointer rete, central pivot, straight rotating sighting rule and circular engraved scales. Keep the warm study setting and light, but instrument should occupy only 70% of image height.
Constraints: no cropped instrument parts, no added labels, names, readable text, logos, watermark, tile lines or frames. The depiction is an identification illustration, not a precision astronomical diagram.
